verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents any built-in AI feature in Logseq that generates insights or suggestions from a user's notes. The documented features are queries, references, plugins, the HTTP API, export, sync and whiteboards, and none of them involve AI. A third-party plugin marketplace and plugin APIs are developer building blocks, not the product's own AI capability, so they earn no credit; for a knowledge-base product this axis applies, and absence of evidence means none.
